Black high-collar long-sleeve costume, blue-violet cloak/cuffs, red/gold brooch and belt, gray uncovered hands and flat cuffed ankle boots retained. Two arms/two legs and full silhouette; left hand holds a closed book low, right hand relaxed, hood down, neutral family composition without romance or adult redesign. Original tower balcony/window over bay, bridge and city is coherent authored environment. Fine chain connectors and gem microgeometry are interpreted, not exact-certified.

observations: Current atlas uses a short squat/chibi silhouette and an ornate purple/gold mage costume: dark trousers, long tabard/waist panels, gold-edged patterned cloak and boots with gold details. These materially differ from the original WB2003 main model.

WB2003 source has a plain black high-neck long-sleeve leotard, gray legs/hands, solid blue-violet hooded cape, matching cuffs/short flat cuffed boots and RED/gold round brooch plus spaced belt stones. Current purple-centered brooch/buckle and extra tabard/trim are unsupported by that source.

Visible forehead red diamond not confirmed in current tiny hooded sprite; do not assert invisible precision. Current ornate floating crystal/tablet graphics are project interpretation, not an independent identity source.

Several atlas regions visibly have horizontal transparent gaps/cuts around boots/head, an additional technical concern separate from character likeness. No technical repair or redraw was attempted in this QA task.
Current file remains preserved as previous project art; the five new CGs use qualified WB2003 sources, not this atlas as authority.
